objective: Add a bounded Google Colab browser-session interoperability surface for the dedicated Colab MCP without granting arbitrary command or F06 worker authority.

security.notes: Browser bridge is local-session scoped, token/origin checked, and does not expose credentials as tool arguments.

conflicts.originalConflict: The earlier Colab MCP was diagnostic-only while real browser-session interoperability was needed.
conflicts.proposedResolution: Add a bounded localhost browser-session bridge while keeping provider execution authority in the canonical adapter and F07 truth outside MCP.
conflicts.acceptedResolution: Browser-session connection lifecycle is isolated in ColabBrowserBridgeManager; no arbitrary command execution is exposed.

changes: Added bounded Colab browser-session connection manager.
Added origin/token validation and lifecycle tools.
Added dedicated interoperability tests and package dependency.
verificationPlan: Pass MCP package typecheck and repository CI.
Verify bridge accepts only approved Colab origins/URLs and rejects unauthorized sessions.
Merge only after current-main validation is green.
